notes.title: ✨LUDIVERS- 2025✨
notes.notes:
[b]Yesterday was a very special day for us![/b]

We had the chance to showcase [b]Plush Party[/b] at [b]Ludivers[/b], and it was an unforgettable experience for the team.

Thank you so much to everyone who stopped by, played the game, and shared such kind words. Seeing so many people laughing, competing, and genuinely enjoying Plush Party [b]filled us with joy and gave us fresh energy to keep going strong[/b].

Events like this remind us why we’re making this game — to bring people together.

If you liked what you saw, don’t forget to add [b]Plush Party[/b] to your Steam [b]wishlist [/b]— it truly means the world to us!

See you at the next one! 🎮💖
[url=https://jugacogi.wordpress.com/]www.jugacogi.com[/url]

notes.title: ✨GIROCÒMIC - 2024✨
notes.notes:
This event was really special for all of us. After more than a year of development we finally could share a beta version of the game with a lot of people [b]ready to have fun![/b]

A huge [b]thank you to everyone[/b] who stopped by to try Plush Party this weekend. It was a joy to see you all having fun and sharing laughs. We can’t wait to bring you more surprises!

If you want to [b]support us,[/b] don't forget to add Plush Party to your [b]wishlist[/b], we will really appreciate it!

See you next time! 🕹️💖

[url=https://jugacogi.com/]jugacogi.com[/url]
